item.title: ULTIMATE ENDGAME Trailer Teases The End Of The Ultimate Universe As Preview Page Reveals Spider-Man Spoiler
item.description: Marvel Comics has released an Avengers: Endgame-inspired trailer for its upcoming Ultimate Endgame event, while a preview page reveals a big change to Peter Parker's status quo.

item.title: Doctor Doom ISN'T Getting An AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Teaser Trailer - Is Marvel Studios Making A Mistake?
item.description: With it now confirmed that Doctor Doom won't take centre stage in one of Avengers: Doomsday's teaser trailers, we can't help but wonder whether Marvel Studios is making a mistake.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: Kate Hudson Turned Down Offer To Play Mary Jane Watson; "It Doesn't Feel Good To Talk About"
item.description: Song Sung Blue star Kate Hudson has revealed that she turned down an offer to play Mary Jane Watson in Sam Raimi's original Spider-Man movie prior to Kirsten Dunst landing the role...

item.title: 3 Reasons The Netflix/Warner Bros. Deal Is Good For DC Studios (And 2 Ways It's Not)
item.description: Netflix is moving full steam ahead with its acquisition of Warner Bros. Pictures. Here's why that's both good and bad for DC Studios and the DCU's future.

item.title: James Gunn Shares Official DCU Holiday Card… And It Might Include The Franchise’s First Damian Wayne Reference
item.description: DC and James Gunn have shared an official DCU holiday card featuring Krypto and, surprisingly, what might be the franchise’s first reference to Damian Wayne’s Robin.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY: Sadie Sink May Be Playing The MCU's Jean Grey, After All
item.description: The speculation surrounding Sadie Sink's role continues, but if the latest scuttlebutt is to be believed, that first rumour about her playing Jean Grey may, in fact, have been correct!

item.title: DC And James Gunn Post Tribute To SUPERMAN And CREATURE COMMANDOS Actor Sean Gunn On Social Media
item.description: DC and James Gunn have shared a fun social media tribute for Sean Gunn, who has portrayed G.I. Robot, Weasel and Maxwell Lord for DC Studios.

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumored To Adapt This Major Punisher Moment From CIVIL WAR With DAREDEVIL Star
item.description: A new rumor claims Spider-Man: Brand New Day will recreate an iconic moment between Spider-Man and the Punisher from the Civil War comics, using a pivotal Daredevil character.

item.title: DAREDEVIL #1 Variant Covers Reveal Gorgeous New Artwork By Alex Maleev, Gabriele Dell'Otto, And More
item.description: New variant covers for March's Daredevil #1, the start of a new era for the Man Without Fear by writer Stephanie Phillips and artist Lee Garbett, have been revealed.
